3d/python.provenance: TC-RDR-03-3D-PYTHON (readme-disposition-remediation-2026-08-18), 2026-08-20. 3d/python is the only Python product in this portfolio whose clone-cache manifest is setup.py-only (no pyproject.toml, no setup.cfg) -- confirmed by checking all 12 python products' clone caches. dependency_extract._extract_pypi_dependencies deliberately refuses to parse a setup.py-only manifest by executing it (a documented security/architecture rule, not a parsing gap), and its own error message names data/dependency_overrides.json as the sanctioned escape hatch. Values here are read directly from setup.py's literal install_requires=[] (empty), extras_require={'dev': ['pytest>=7.0.0']}, and python_requires='>=3.7' -- not invented.

psd/python.provenance: 2026-10-07, readme-refresh onboarding for psd/python. This repo has NO packaging manifest of any kind -- no pyproject.toml, no setup.cfg, and no setup.py (a strictly more severe gap than 3d/python's setup.py-only case above). dependency_extract.py's own plan()-time error names data/dependency_overrides.json as the sanctioned escape hatch for exactly this case. Required/optional are empty because a real grep of every `import`/`from` statement in aspose_psd_foss/ (the library itself, not its tests) found only stdlib modules (typing, enum, io, hashlib, math, struct, sys, abc, os, copy) and internal aspose_psd_foss.* imports -- zero third-party imports anywhere. The one development dependency (pytest) is confirmed by the same method against aspose_psd_foss_test/. Nothing here is invented; everything traces to a literal import statement or language-feature use in the real source.
